selected_script.angle: A stressed home cook tackles a soaking-wet, cluttered countertop by setting up a 2-tier matte black dish rack, directly routing drainage into the sink.
selected_script.hook: Tired of dealing with water pooling all over your kitchen counter?

script_record.pain_point: Messy countertops with water pooling next to the sink
script_record.conflict_hook: Tired of dealing with water pooling all over your kitchen counter?
script_record.product_solution: 2-Tier Carbon Steel Kitchen Dish Drying Rack with automatic drainage

timeline.scene: A stressed home user looking at a messy, wet kitchen countertop next to the sink with plates and bowls piled unsafely in a puddle of water.
Introduce the Matte Black 2-tier carbon steel dish drying rack placing it next to the sink to replace the messy pile.
First-person POV showing hands snapping the side bracket of upper rack A into the bottom base slot B by pushing down to snap-lock.
Close-up showing a hand hanging the side utensil caddy and cutting board rack onto the outer side wire frame.
A hand rotating and extending the bottom 360-degree drainage spout so it extends over the kitchen sink edge, showing water draining out smoothly.
Clean countertop display with the loaded rack. Caption/Voiceover: Make your space cleaner and cozier.

script_record.cta: Make your space cleaner and cozier.
